scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace frontend && npm test --workspace backend
scripts.verify:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:fast && npm run build && npm run test:emulator
scripts.verify:flutter:fast: cd frontend && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.verify:flutter:full: npm run verify:flutter:fast && cd frontend && flutter build apk --debug
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build --workspace backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-trip-split --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:emulator:run --workspace backend"
